Questions

What format is it?

A 107-page PDF in English. You get it by email right after payment, and you can read it on any device.

Can I upload it to my AI?

Yes, that's how it was designed. Every section has an AI read note, and Section 17 tells you how to set up a Claude Project or a similar workspace so your AI writes with these rules.

Do you charge monthly?

No. This is a one-time payment. You pay once and the playbook is yours to keep. No subscription, no hidden fees.

Why is it so cheap?

Others charge thousands of dollars for monthly courses. I want this to be accessible to every scriptwriter, wherever they live, because I know how much it costs to learn this the hard way. One fair price, and you get everything I use with my own clients.

Are the scripts and client details real?

Yes. The scripts are real delivered work. Client names, brands and some numbers in the scripts are anonymized to protect the people involved.
